author: Mlyn4yk
quote: I understand why this game is considered a classic, but playing it today was a disappointing experience. The world feels empty, exploration is often tedious, and the gameplay hasn’t aged particularly well. Clunky controls, frustrating camera angles, and excessive backtracking make the experience feel more like a chore than an adventure. I appreciate its historical significance and influence on the industry, but nostalgia alone can’t make up for outdated mechanics and frustrating design. Perhaps it was revolutionary in its time, but by modern standards, I found it overrated and difficult to enjoy.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Mlyn4yk
quote: What impressed me the most is the incredibly vast, detailed, and vibrant open world. It feels so alive and carefully crafted that I honestly doubt anyone will be able to come close to this level of detail and scale in the next few years. It’s the kind of world where you simply want to explore, take your time, and enjoy everything around you without feeling the need to rush from one mission to **** main characters are equally well-developed. Their personalities, individual storylines, and evolving relationship make them genuinely interesting to follow. I found myself invested in seeing how their stories unfold and how their relationship develops throughout the game.Technical performance is also excellent. The game runs smoothly on my PS5, maintaining a stable 30 FPS throughout my experience. I haven’t encountered any bugs or noticeable technical issues so far. My only minor complaint is that the autosave system could be clearer, as it’s not always obvious how exactly it works.Overall, GTA VI sets an incredibly high standard for open-world games. It’s a world you don’t just play through — it’s a world you want to live in and keep discovering.
